title: NSA TREAT Men in Black unit

tellings.quote: it's the supposed uh men in black uh unit out of the NSA called the tactical reconnaissance engineering assessment search team which was created by Stubbleine

plain: The NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, supposedly had a "men in black" unit, a team that quietly deals with UFO witnesses and evidence, called the Tactical Reconnaissance Engineering Assessment Search Team, created by a man named Albert Stubblebine. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this, drawing on emails from what he calls the DPI archive and on names such as Edgar Fouche and Hans-Adam II. If true, it would mean a real government team exists to handle UFO matters out of sight.
